title: Automation Mechanical Technician -2nd Shift
eligibility_reason: location mentions Maine area: Brunswick, ME
description:
At L.L.Bean, we believe the outdoors brings out the best in all of us. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging and creating safe, inclusive spaces where everyone feels welcome—both here and Outside. We value individual differences and are dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment where everyone can bring the best of their experience and talents and truly thrive.
We're looking for an Automation Mechanical Technician to join our talented Maintenance team at our innovative manufacturing facility in Brunswick, Maine . If you enjoy solving complex mechanical and automation challenges and want to be part of a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.
What we offer:
Competitive pay
Excellent benefits
A generous employee discount
A chance to be part of a legendary brand
Come be part of something special at L.L.Bean!
Performs all automated maintenance functions requiring advanced knowledge of fluid power, electrical, mechanical power transmission, distribution, utilization, and control of electrical energy up to 480 volts AC. Serve as automation, fluid power and mechanical safety oversight resource across the company to leaders, engineering, project managers, risk management, etc. for any concerns related to equipment operation and repair safety in the workplace
Responsibilities
Fulfillment or Manufacturing Support
Applies advanced knowledge of decision-making processes, precautionary techniques, job planning, personal protective equipment, and test equipment to recognize and avoid hazards.
Provides second level support for complex problems to all departments for all things mechanically automated.
Install, maintain, and support complex Kuka robot system, automated, pneumatic, cutting, packaging, sorting equipment, high speed sewing and production equipment, injection molding and carton and product transport systems and equipment.
Performs preventative maintenance functions on a variety of complex industrial equipment as scheduled.
Follows procedures and properly handles Universal Waste per state guidelines.
Maintains accurate documentation of all new and existing installations.
Acts as internal resource providing support and expertise required for projects and maintenance. May act as project lead. Oversees the work of automated equipment contractors and vendors.
Applies computer skills to troubleshoot and repair automated industrial utilizing and adjusting parameter settings on (HMI, VFD and IO) controlled equipment.
Collaborates with internal clients in support of new and existing technology requirements.
Mentor and support and support all technicians, regardless of title and level.
Identifies hazardous conditions or actions that may cause injury or property damage and ensures action to abate them.
Assures appropriate communication of issues/problems to coworkers and leadership. Shares expertise in support of others to build technical and diagnostic strength in the team.
Provides coverage at designated times as required to meet business demands and off shift shutdowns.
Assumes additional responsibilities as assigned.
This position has been identified as a safety-sensitive position. A safety-sensitive position is one in which an impaired worker constitutes a serious and direct threat to workplace health and safety. Employees in this position must agree that they will not come to work or be at work at any time under the influence of alcohol or any drug that could render them impaired.
Garage Support Position
Technician with the ability to work on gasoline and or diesel engines, trailers, and all types of outdoor equipment. Must be able to diagnose and make repairs quickly, must be able to perform tune-ups, and oil changes on gas and diesel engines, perform brake work, mount tires, make trailer repairs, and have a working knowledge of electric systems and EFI.
Performing routine maintenance tasks such as oil changes and tire rotation to ensure that company vehicles are running smoothly
Repairing vehicles using various tools such as hydraulic jacks and pneumatic lifts
Troubleshooting electrical problems such as faulty starters or alternators
Experience with the following: diesel engine repairs, t [...] ms.
Education Level: Highschool or GED; Vocational/Technical Degree is preferred but not required
Skills and Qualifications
Industrial equipment maintenance experience required
Strong interpersonal and communication skills both written and verbal.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to create and maintain accurate documentation
Knowledge and experience with NFPA 70E (Electrical Safety in the Workplace)
Able to troubleshoot complex controls including experience adjusting and programming parameter settings with HMI’s, I.O.’s, VFD’s
Ability to work with various 24-hour emergency support groups
Experience reading hydraulic, and pneumatic schematics.
Ability to collaborate at many levels internally and externally
Self-motivated, able to work independently and provide guidance and support to JR technicians
L.L.Bean uses a market-based compensation approach. The anticipated starting base pay for this position is $28.68-$34.42. Individual compensation may vary based on factors such as a candidate’s experience, qualifications, education, geographic location, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.
If you care about the outdoors, joining L.L.Bean is a great way to feel good about what you do. Our benefits package makes a good thing even better, with programs and perks designed to support your health and financial goals. Plus, maintaining a healthy work-life balance and re-charging outside are all part of the plan.
If your experience looks a little different from what we've identified and you think you'd be great at this role, we'd love to learn more about you! At L.L.Bean, we believe the outdoors brings out the best in all of us. We strive to reflect this every day in our commitments to employees and partners and in our efforts to promote belonging.

score.why: Industrial maintenance role servicing Kuka robots, pneumatics and 480V equipment at L.L.Bean's Brunswick plant — hands-on mechanical/electrical work, not software test engineering, so it misses the candidate's QA/SDET focus.
score.notes: On-site Brunswick, outside Bangor-area commute targets; requires industrial maintenance/NFPA 70E, no software testing content.
